svg.title: Object Model — Canonical Core
svg.desc: UML-style object model of pytex.core: reference frames and transforms, symmetry specifications, lattice, unit cell and phase, rotations and orientations, and the Miller plane, direction and zone-axis objects, with composition and association edges taken from the declared field types.
svg.text: Frames, symmetry, lattice and phase, orientation, and Miller objects, read from the dataclass fields that declare them
composition - a required field: the owner cannot exist without it
association - an optional or defaulted field
* after a field name: the field holds a sequence
Phase is the join: one lattice, one symmetry, one crystal frame.
A Miller object becomes a CrystalPlane or CrystalDirection once bound to a phase.
ProvenanceRecord is omitted: 100 classes carry it, on every result object.
Fields naming another card are listed first; the rest are summarized.
